D’Alesio&Santoro Srl is a Milan-based independent design-and-engineering company specialised in the use of light as both a cultural medium and a technical tool. Founded in 2010 by Carlo D’Alesio and Piero Santoro, the company has developed a multidisciplinary practice spanning architectural lighting, custom luminaire design, integrated lighting systems, optical problem-solving, human-centric lighting, and technology-oriented prototyping. Its portfolio includes transportation infrastructure, hospitality, luxury retail, exhibition design, branded environments, bespoke product development and site-specific lighting systems delivered across multiple countries and technical contexts.

Beyond its public profile as an international lighting design practice, D’Alesio&Santoro also operates as a research-driven organisation with strong capabilities in physical prototyping, light-guides and luminous interfaces, custom fixtures, performance-oriented engineering and development of special light-based devices. The company’s human-centric lighting capability includes visual-comfort-oriented lighting strategies, daylight/artificial-light integration, dynamic light modulation, scene-setting logic and user-oriented control approaches for environments where well-being, perception and behavioural support are relevant design parameters.

Since 2026, these capabilities have been significantly expanded through the incorporation of MEG as D’Alesio&Santoro’s internal skunk works for applied photobiology, precision non-human lighting and advanced hardware/software R&D. This integrated capability brings expertise in programmable light platforms, controlled-environment systems, experimental chambers, radiometric assessment, microalgae- and plant-related systems, UV devices and custom payload-scale solutions for constrained research setups.

As a result, D’Alesio&Santoro can be positioned not only as a lighting design firm, but as a light-centred design, prototyping and engineering partner for projects where performance, experimentation, human-centric lighting quality and custom system development are essential.

description:
The University of Essex presents a highly credible, technically aligned partner to European Space Agency, combining deep expertise in AI, embedded systems, robotics, and advanced communications with a strong track record in real-world deployment and cross-sector collaboration. Its capabilities are particularly relevant to ESA’s evolving roadmap around autonomous systems, resilient infrastructure, and data-driven mission architectures. The university’s strengths in intelligent systems, secure data environments, and high-performance computing position it to support both spaceborne and ground-segment innovation, while its commercialisation and funding expertise enables effective translation from research into deployable solutions.

This translates into a set of clearly defined contribution areas:

* AI, autonomy and onboard intelligence: development of edge AI, multi-agent systems, and explainable models enabling real-time, autonomous decision-making in satellites and mission systems
* Robotics and physical AI: autonomous robotics for in-orbit servicing, inspection, and planetary exploration, alongside simulation and validation environments
* Advanced communications and navigation: 6G-enabled satellite-terrestrial integration, resilient communication architectures, and GNSS-denied positioning systems
* Data systems and Earth observation analytics: AI-driven processing of EO data, large-scale data fusion, and predictive analytics for climate and operational insights
* Cybersecurity and secure infrastructure: end-to-end encryption, cyber-resilience frameworks, and secure AI model deployment for mission-critical systems
* Embedded systems and space-grade integration: low-power, fault-tolerant embedded architectures and hardware–software co-design for constrained environments
* Simulation, modelling and digital twins: high-fidelity simulation environments and digital twins for mission planning, optimisation, and lifecycle management
* Commercialisation and ecosystem enablement: structuring ESA-aligned funding pathways, building consortia, and scaling dual-use technologies into space markets
* Sustainability and space environment monitoring: space debris tracking, energy-efficient systems, and EO-enabled environmental monitoring
* Human-centric systems and decision support: AI-assisted tools for mission control, human–machine teaming, and advanced operator interfaces

Overall, Essex can be positioned as a full-stack innovation partner, capable of supporting ESA from early-stage research through to deployment and commercial scale, bridging technical depth with execution capability in a rapidly evolving space ecosystem.

NanoMAR AS is a newly established Norwegian enterprise focused on revolutionizing water treatment through the application of advanced nanotechnology. Founded in 2023 by recognized researchers in biology and water quality, the company develops a patented, chemical-free nanobubble system designed to efficiently remove ultra-fine particles, dissolved substances, bacteria, and viruses from water. The innovative technology offers over 30% higher cleaning efficiency and lower energy consumption compared to current Best Available Technology (BAT). 

By integrating our advanced nanobubble technology with European space assets, NanoMAR transforms reactive water treatment into a proactive, automated defense system for marine aquaculture. Utilizing Satellite Earth Observation (SatEO) data to monitor sea surface temperatures and predict the trajectory of Harmful Algae Blooms (HABs) like Pseudochattonella, alongside SatCom for real-time remote activation, our solution establishes a preemptive protective barrier around offshore fish farms. Because the system uses no chemicals and low cost energy, it can be safely triggered via satellite API at the first sign of an algal anomaly without financial or environmental risk, directly supporting the ESA's mission to ensure resilient, sustainable, and responsible fishing practices.

entityDescription: Missionware is a technology company specialising in the design and development of advanced software platforms for real-time systems, geospatial applications, and mission-critical operational environments. The company focuses on building digital platforms that collect, integrate, and visualise operational data in real time in order to support monitoring, coordination, and decision-making in complex environments. Missionware develops software solutions across several domains including intelligent mobility systems, situational awareness platforms, infrastructure monitoring, and geospatial data processing solutions. A key area of expertise of the company is the development of platforms that combine real-time data ingestion, geospatial information, and operational visualisation into unified applications that allow operators to monitor vehicles, assets, and infrastructure in real time. These systems are typically used in operational environments where accurate situational awareness and timely decision-making are essential. Missionware has developed the Cognibase real-time platform, a high-performance software platform designed for building applications that require continuous data synchronisation, event processing, and real-time operational monitoring. Cognibase enables the rapid development of distributed systems that synchronise operational data between backend services and user interfaces, allowing multiple users to observe and interact with the same operational data in real time. The platform is particularly suitable for applications involving vehicle fleets, sensors, and geospatial information. These technologies support the development of systems that provide operators with a shared operational picture of dynamic environments and allow the monitoring of vehicles, assets, and events through interactive geospatial interfaces. Missionware’s engineering team has strong expertise in software architecture, real-time data systems, geospatial software development, and mobile application development. The company develops cross-platform location-based mobile applications and backend services that integrate location data from mobile devices, vehicles, and sensor, operational events, and other data streams into unified platforms that support monitoring and coordination tasks.

entityDescription:
Atlas – Carbon Neutral Solution S.r.l. Benefit is a climate-tech startup developing digital infrastructures for the measurement, certification, and traceability of environmental data and CO₂ emissions, with applications across energy, agriculture, mobility, and industrial sectors.
The company has designed a proprietary framework based on MRV (Monitoring, Reporting, Verification) principles, integrating:
multi-source data acquisition (IoT sensors, satellite data, and enterprise inputs) 
ESG and carbon footprint analytical algorithms 
digital certification systems 
blockchain-based registration to ensure transparency, immutability, and auditability 
At the core of the platform is the B.R.A.I.N. Engine (Blockchain, Reduction, Aerospace, internazional, Network), which enables the transformation of environmental data into verifiable and auditable outputs, supporting ESG reporting, environmental certifications, and carbon credit generation.
Atlas positions itself as a neutral digital infrastructure layer, connecting companies, environmental projects, and certification bodies without replacing them, while enabling a new standard based on objective, data-driven sustainability.
The platform integrates advanced technologies such as satellite data, digital twin modeling, and blockchain, allowing scalable monitoring, validation, and optimization of environmental performance.
Key applications include:
automated sustainability reporting (CSRD, GRI compliant) 
monitoring and certification of environmental projects (e.g., regenerative agriculture, agrivoltaics) 
generation and management of verifiable carbon credits 
ESG software solutions for SMEs and large enterprises 
Atlas operates at the intersection of ESG software, climate-tech, and carbon markets, with the ambition to become a European digital infrastructure for trusted environmental data management and certification.
